actualCompetingCliOwners.scope: Owned actual Git, source capture and two independent real CLI processes. Both request revision0; exactly one step publishes and the other refuses stale revision without stdout. This separate process-race gate is not added to Cargo result-group totals.

summary.scope: Full default Windows native all-target run after persistent local history jobs and typed retention changes, plus separate actual OS/TLS CLI gates, Python17 and TypeScript mandatory checks. This proves finite local traversal, restart/revision and mapping behavior only. Host-gated ignored cases, unattended App integration, production/remote-source/semantic reasoning and full STATUS/upstream equivalence remain open. Preserve all failures and their exact source scope; do not equate a default run with all live or hosted platform certification.

findings: Explicit durable local history acquisition reconstructs date-priority parent discovery from verified raw commit objects and ordered visits. Unknown fields, missing/unrelated/hash-invalid proofs and reordered visits refuse. All pending timestamps are admitted before selection; object-count and byte-batch boundaries can checkpoint lookahead without visiting a partially verified frontier.

Current host job/capture/write/Git-trust permissions and App repository grants are supplied on every operation, not serialized as authority. Jobs freeze original head, direct disk origin, analyzer and cumulative quotas. Exact revisions fence stale/lost-response writes. Pause/resume/cancel preserve terminal-state rules. Read-only existing-state status reports recorded capture references and never claims freshly replayed historical source bodies.

Each step owns one immediate WAL/FULL-or-EXTRA SQL transaction, including every native capture, scope/receipt/FTS row, current batch source replay/mapping, job update and exact output admission. Late SQL/output/Git/lock/expiry failures leave the previous checkpoint and all earlier published rows unchanged. Inert unreferenced CAS bytes can remain after rollback. Checkout, Git index/refs/config, latest, network/model/provider and credentials are unchanged.

Thirteen actual Git/SQLite/CLI cases cover histories larger than one mapping batch, process/Store restart, SHA1/SHA256 and epochs8/9, Unicode/CRLF, branched clock skew/equal-date ordering, partial frontier hydration, cumulative source/capture/proof/object/parent limits, stale revisions, revoked grants, pause/resume/cancel, forged/swapped references, SQL/output rollback, missing objects, lock deadlines, typed retention and default host denials.

Thirteen additional actual CLI host-path/protocol cases use the identical final native binary and valid current host permissions. A positive host-file control reaches the expected missing-existing-Store refusal; relative profile/request/plan paths, parent components, Windows device-prefix/ADS forms, a real unprivileged junction ancestor, duplicate/authority-bearing plan fields and unknown request/profile fields refuse earlier without output disclosure or Store creation. Existing-only status also refuses missing state. These counts are separate and do not replace any symbolic-link fixture prerequisite failure.

Two actual independent CLI processes race the same revision0 on an owned real Git/capture fixture: exactly one atomic step succeeds and the other refuses stale revision with empty stdout. A separate read-only process and direct read-only SQL inspection agree on revision1 and exactly two visited commits, with source/index/HEAD/latest unchanged. The first Python inspection fixture left its read connection open until cleanup and failed with Windows32; explicit contextlib.closing fixes the fixture and the complete rerun passes, with no Rust change. Raw fixture source/error and final receipts are retained.

Development includes a compile-only private-field fixture mistake, corrected by parsing a genuinely revoked host profile. Ten then thirteen cases passed. An additional proof-byte boundary test then genuinely failed; the traversal now checkpoints already admitted lookahead when only the current byte remainder is too small, while an object that cannot fit a fresh batch refuses. Final source also exercises SHA256 under explicit epoch9. Raw development attempts are unfrozen historical diagnostics; the complete final run has exact unchanged source manifests.

Ordinary reversible NTFS compression of 3472 owned older release build files preserved every SHA256 while the separate frozen debug build ran. No deletion, WOF optimized mode, compiler/test-option, Windows security or system compression setting change was made. Raw logs and file hashes are retained.

Unattended App history integration, production deployment, live App installation, remote source ownership/verification, semantic reasoning, universal upstream equivalence and remaining full STATUS requirements remain open. Native default ignored host gates and hosted platform acceptance are distinct. Original inventory ledger and historical certification states remain unchanged. No main merge, release or public comment is claimed.
